Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)

parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)

fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.

Observed image bounds, normalized from the top-left: the main bunks occupy approximately `(0.01, 0.27)–(0.53, 0.90)`, the wardrobe `(0.54, 0.34)–(0.67, 0.68)`, the fireplace `(0.67, 0.38)–(0.90, 0.70)`, and the foreground bunk `(0.90, 0.00)–(1.00, 1.00)`. The back-wall floor boundary runs roughly from `(0.45, 0.65)` to `(0.91, 0.70)`. Floor seams converge toward the back center; left-wall beams and bed rails recede toward the upper right. White mattresses sit within thin charcoal frames, leaving substantial open space beneath and between bunks. The foreground right bunk occludes the room edge; the left bunks overlap each other and partially conceal the left wall. Depth, hidden bed ends, and exact room dimensions are assumptions.

Parameters below expose the camera position, target, lens, room dimensions, and bed dimensions. Source checks: all dimensions are positive, rods have distinct endpoints, repeated parts have unique keys, and camera, lights, and procedural materials are created after `realize`. No rendering, saving, or external access is included.

from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math
import random

random.seed(13)

# Main reconstruction parameters, in metres.
ROOM_W, ROOM_D, ROOM_H = 6.4, 7.6, 3.55
BACK_Y, LEFT_X = 4.65, -3.2
BED_W, BED_L = 1.18, 2.38
CAMERA_POSITION = (2.15, -5.35, 1.82)
CAMERA_TARGET = (-0.30, 2.35, 1.56)
CAMERA_LENS = 30

scene = Scene(name="Historic bunk room")
plaster = (0.68, 0.70, 0.43)
ceiling_color = (0.62, 0.66, 0.47)
timber = (0.16, 0.105, 0.055)
metal = (0.105, 0.125, 0.12)
linen = (0.86, 0.89, 0.86)
stone = (0.43, 0.42, 0.32)
wood = (0.30, 0.15, 0.055)

architecture = Asset("Plaster walls and ceiling")
architecture.include("back_wall",
    box((ROOM_W, .18, ROOM_H), center=(0, BACK_Y+.09, ROOM_H/2), color=plaster))
architecture.include("left_wall",
    box((.16, ROOM_D, ROOM_H), center=(LEFT_X-.08, .9, ROOM_H/2),
        color=(.70, .70, .51)))
architecture.include("ceiling",
    box((ROOM_W, ROOM_D, .14), center=(0, .9, ROOM_H+.07),
        color=ceiling_color))
scene.include("architecture", architecture)

floor = Asset("Long worn floorboards")
# Board joins and occasional end joints remain visible without a dense grid.
for i in range(23):
    x = LEFT_X + (i+.5)*.282
    split = random.uniform(.6, 2.8)
    for j, (ya, yb) in enumerate(((-2.9, split), (split+.012, BACK_Y))):
        tint = random.uniform(.88, 1.12)
        floor.include(f"board_{i}_{j}",
            box((.274, yb-ya, .075),
                center=(x, (ya+yb)/2, -.042),
                color=(.30*tint, .195*tint, .105*tint)))
scene.include("floorboards", floor)

beams = Asset("Exposed structural timbers")
for i, y in enumerate((-1.75, .3, 2.3, 4.48)):
    beams.include(f"wall_post_{i}",
        box((.145, .16, ROOM_H), center=(LEFT_X+.045, y, ROOM_H/2),
            color=timber))
for i, z in enumerate((1.95, 3.38)):
    beams.include(f"wall_rail_{i}",
        box((.15, ROOM_D, .15), center=(LEFT_X+.045, .9, z), color=timber))
for i, y in enumerate((-.8, 3.35)):
    beams.include(f"ceiling_crossbeam_{i}",
        box((ROOM_W, .23, .23), center=(0, y, ROOM_H-.08), color=timber))
scene.include("timbers", beams)

def make_bunk(name, cx, cy, width=BED_W, length=BED_L,
              bottom=.49, upper=1.84, height=2.35, bedding=True):
    a = Asset(name)
    x0, x1 = cx-width/2, cx+width/2
    y0, y1 = cy-length/2, cy+length/2

    for ix, x in enumerate((x0, x1)):
        for iy, y in enumerate((y0, y1)):
            a.include(f"post_{ix}_{iy}",
                rod(.027, start=(x,y,.04), end=(x,y,height), color=metal))
            a.include(f"foot_{ix}_{iy}",
                box((.10,.10,.025), center=(x,y,.025), color=metal))
            a.include(f"cap_{ix}_{iy}",
                ball(.032, center=(x,y,height), color=metal))

    for level, z in enumerate((bottom, upper)):
        a.include(f"deck_{level}",
            box((width, length, .065), center=(cx,cy,z), color=(.13,.15,.14)))
        for ix, x in enumerate((x0,x1)):
            a.include(f"long_frame_{level}_{ix}",
                rod(.024, start=(x,y0,z+.02), end=(x,y1,z+.02), color=metal))
        if bedding:
            a.include(f"mattress_{level}",
                box((width-.075,length-.06,.145),
                    center=(cx,cy,z+.10), color=linen))
            a.include(f"pillow_{level}",
                fillet_box((width*.73,.43,.15), radius=.065,
                    center=(cx,y1-.33,z+.24), color=(.94,.94,.88)))
            a.include(f"folded_sheet_{level}",
                box((width-.065,.50,.055),
                    center=(cx,y0+.34,z+.193), color=(.79,.84,.84)))
        # End rails have clear gaps above the mattresses.
        for iy,y in enumerate((y0,y1)):
            for rail,h in enumerate((.29,.44)):
                a.include(f"end_rail_{level}_{iy}_{rail}",
                    rod(.018, start=(x0,y,z+h), end=(x1,y,z+h), color=metal))
        # Upper wall-side safety rails.
        if level == 1:
            for rail,h in enumerate((.29,.43)):
                a.include(f"side_guard_{rail}",
                    rod(.019, start=(x0,y0,z+h), end=(x0,y1,z+h),
                        color=metal))

    # Ladder on the exposed long side, retaining open space below the bed.
    ladder_y = y0+.53
    for k,y in enumerate((ladder_y-.22,ladder_y+.22)):
        a.include(f"ladder_upright_{k}",
            rod(.022, start=(x1+.018,y,.12),
                end=(x1+.018,y,upper+.42), color=metal))
    for k in range(6):
        z = .30+k*.30
        a.include(f"ladder_rung_{k}",
            rod(.018, start=(x1+.025,ladder_y-.22,z),
                end=(x1+.025,ladder_y+.22,z), color=metal))
    return a

scene.include("front_left_bunk",
    make_bunk("Main left bunk", -2.19, .10))
scene.include("rear_left_bunk",
    make_bunk("Rear left bunk", -1.85, 2.72, width=1.12, length=2.24))

# Cropped bed very close to the camera on the right.
foreground = make_bunk("Foreground right bunk", 3.22, -1.45,
                       width=1.18, length=2.45,
                       bottom=.47, upper=1.87, height=2.65)
foreground.include("warm_wood_end",
    box((.075,.10,2.65), center=(2.57,-2.66,1.325),
        color=(.45,.23,.07)))
scene.include("foreground_bunk", foreground)

wardrobe = Asset("Narrow oak wardrobe")
wx, wy, ww, wh, wd = -.05, 4.25, .90, 1.92, .48
for i,x in enumerate((wx-ww/2+.055,wx+ww/2-.055)):
    wardrobe.include(f"side_{i}",
        box((.085,wd,wh), center=(x,wy,wh/2+.06), color=wood))
    wardrobe.include(f"foot_{i}",
        box((.12,.36,.10), center=(x,wy,.05), color=(.23,.105,.035)))
wardrobe.include("back",
    box((ww,.05,wh), center=(wx,wy+wd/2-.025,wh/2+.06),
        color=(.19,.085,.027)))
for key,z,thick in (("base",.15,.10),("middle_shelf",.72,.055),
                    ("top",1.99,.09),("cornice",2.05,.055)):
    wardrobe.include(key,
        box((ww+(.10 if key=="cornice" else 0),wd+.055,thick),
            center=(wx,wy-.015,z), color=wood))
# Left door, right open hanging compartment.
wardrobe.include("left_door",
    box((.40,.055,1.75), center=(wx-.225,wy-wd/2-.025,1.045),
        color=(.34,.18,.063)))
for i,z in enumerate((.55,1.48)):
    wardrobe.include(f"door_panel_{i}",
        box((.30,.018,.67), center=(wx-.225,wy-wd/2-.059,z),
            color=(.295,.145,.045)))
wardrobe.include("door_knob",
    ball(.022, center=(wx-.065,wy-wd/2-.09,1.04),
         color=(.15,.12,.055)))
wardrobe.include("hanging_rail",
    rod(.015,start=(wx+.025,wy-.06,1.81),
        end=(wx+.36,wy-.06,1.81),color=metal))
for i in range(3):
    x=wx+.08+i*.09
    wardrobe.include(f"hanger_{i}",
        rod(.009,start=(x,wy-.06,1.78),
            end=(x+.055,wy-.06,1.66),color=(.20,.17,.12)))
scene.include("wardrobe", wardrobe)

fireplace = Asset("Stone fireplace and dark hearth")
fx, fy = 1.62, 4.48
# Dark recessed opening behind the separate stone surround.
fireplace.include("recess",
    box((1.42,.10,1.15), center=(fx,fy-.025,.60),
        color=(.10,.095,.075)))
fireplace.include("hearth",
    box((2.02,.83,.07), center=(fx,fy-.37,.035),
        color=(.32,.30,.235)))
for i,x in enumerate((fx-.88,fx+.88)):
    fireplace.include(f"stone_jamb_{i}",
        box((.30,.29,1.15), center=(x,fy-.11,.61),color=stone))
fireplace.include("broad_top_lintel",
    box((2.07,.31,.26), center=(fx,fy-.11,1.30),
        color=(.48,.47,.36)))
fireplace.include("inner_top_lintel",
    box((1.48,.23,.14), center=(fx,fy-.19,1.12),
        color=(.39,.39,.30)))
# A few irregular masonry courses visible inside the soot-dark opening.
for row in range(7):
    z=.16+row*.128
    for col in range(4):
        x=fx-.55+col*.31+(row%2)*.075
        if x < fx+.64:
            tint=random.uniform(.75,1.1)
            fireplace.include(f"brick_{row}_{col}",
                box((.28,.035,.105),center=(x,fy-.094,z),
                    color=(.20*tint,.185*tint,.14*tint)))
for i in range(3):
    fireplace.include(f"ash_log_{i}",
        rod(.038,start=(fx-.40+i*.24,fy-.30,.12),
            end=(fx-.13+i*.24,fy-.41,.14),color=(.11,.105,.08)))
scene.include("fireplace",fireplace)

radiator = Asset("Small leaning hearth radiator")
# Pale narrow vertical fins on the right side of the fire opening.
for i in range(8):
    x=2.08+i*.036
    radiator.include(f"fin_{i}",
        rod(.012,start=(x,4.03,.10),end=(x-.07,4.11,.53),
            color=(.68,.71,.67)))
for i,z in enumerate((.13,.51)):
    radiator.include(f"crossbar_{i}",
        rod(.016,start=(2.05,4.06,z),end=(2.35,4.06,z),
            color=(.65,.68,.64)))
scene.include("radiator",radiator)

accessories=Asset("Room accessories")
accessories.include("coal_scuttle",
    rod(.10,start=(2.67,4.09,.04),end=(2.67,4.09,.29),
        color=(.09,.105,.095)))
accessories.include("poker",
    rod(.012,start=(2.74,4.10,.08),end=(2.74,4.10,.76),
        color=metal))
# Round wall plate above the wardrobe.
accessories.include("wall_plate",
    rod(.105,start=(.10,4.535,2.39),end=(.10,4.565,2.39),
        color=(.46,.55,.49)))
accessories.include("plate_center",
    ball(.016,center=(.10,4.51,2.39),color=(.65,.68,.56)))
# Simple wall fittings above the beds.
for i,y in enumerate((.35,2.80)):
    accessories.include(f"bed_wall_fitting_{i}",
        box((.10,.12,.21),center=(-3.075,y,2.44),
            color=(.26,.31,.27)))
scene.include("accessories",accessories)

realize(scene)

# Procedural surface variation; no image textures.
def textured_material(mat, kind):
    mat.use_nodes=True
    nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
    links=mat.node_tree.links
    bsdf=nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if not bsdf:
        return
    base=tuple(bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value)
    tex=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=5 if kind=="wood" else 7
    tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=3
    coord=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mapping=nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    mapping.operation='MULTIPLY'
    mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(24,1.4,5) if kind=="wood" else (1,1,1)
    links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
    links.new(mapping.outputs[0],tex.inputs["Vector"])
    ramp=nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.18
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.82
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=tuple(v*.72 for v in base[:3])+(1,)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=tuple(min(v*1.13,1) for v in base[:3])+(1,)
    links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
    links.new(ramp.outputs[0],bsdf.inputs["Base Color"])
    bump=nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.19
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.035 if kind=="wood" else .018
    links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    links.new(bump.outputs[0],bsdf.inputs["Normal"])
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.83

# Finish classification uses the actual material color, independent of mesh names.
for mat in list(bpy.data.materials):
    mat.use_nodes=True
    bsdf=mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if not bsdf:
        continue
    r,g,b,_=bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
    if r > g*1.20 and g > b*1.18:
        textured_material(mat,"wood")
    elif .30 < r < .77 and .29 < g < .78 and b < .60:
        textured_material(mat,"plaster")
    elif max(r,g,b)<.19:
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.55
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.36
    else:
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.84

set_view(CAMERA_POSITION,CAMERA_TARGET,lens=CAMERA_LENS,sensor=36)
world_scene=bpy.context.scene
if world_scene.world is None:
    world_scene.world=bpy.data.worlds.new("Room ambient")
world_scene.world.use_nodes=True
world_scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Color"].default_value=(.65,.72,.78,1)
world_scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Strength"].default_value=.30
area_emitter((-.5,-3.4,3.1),power=1050,size=4.0,
             target=(-1.1,1.6,.6),color=(.91,.95,1.0))
area_emitter((2.7,1.0,3.05),power=260,size=3.0,
             target=(.5,3.8,1.0),color=(1.0,.91,.70))
world_scene.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
